title: Precedent and Split-Leakage Audit for Neural Recommender

verdict.summary: REJECT GAP: Observed gain comes from preprocessing leakage and untuned baselines, not a new method [run_logs/split_audit_2026.json]. Auditing four splits shows the claimed 12.4% lift vanishes once scaler leakage is fixed.

key_evidence.claim: Fixing pre-split normalization drops test NDCG@10 from 0.418 to 0.311.
Tuned ItemKNN reaches 0.314 NDCG@10 on the same clean split.
124 duplicate user-item pairs appear in both train and test folds.

flaws_and_risks.summary: StandardScaler runs on the full matrix before train-test splitting.
Baseline ItemKNN uses default k=5 instead of tuned grid k in [50, 400].
Only 1 random seed is reported without variance bounds.

next_steps.action: Move feature scaling strictly inside the training fold pipeline.
Re-run tuned ItemKNN across 5 fixed seeds and log SHA-256 receipts.
Drop the novelty claim unless the new model beats tuned ItemKNN on clean folds.
